mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shenlun_paper (paper_code, title, year, version, question_count, create_time) VALUES (#{paperCode}, #{title}, #{year}, #{version}, #{questionCount}, NOW())
INSERT INTO shenlun_material (paper_id, m_no, title, content) VALUES (#{paperId}, #{mNo}, #{title}, #{content})
INSERT INTO shenlun_question (paper_id, qno, title, score, word_limit, ref_answer) VALUES (#{paperId}, #{qno}, #{title}, #{score}, #{wordLimit}, #{refAnswer})
INSERT INTO shenlun_answer (user_id, paper_id, content, grade_json, status, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{paperId}, #{content}, #{gradeJson}, #{status}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.paper_id AS paperId, a.content, a.grade_json AS gradeJson, a.status, a.create_time AS createTime, p.title AS paperTitle, p.year FROM shenlun_answer a JOIN shenlun_paper p ON p.id = a.paper_id WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY a.create_time DESC
